General

  1. 1. This Copyright Policy governs the use of copyrighted materials on the WeMall online marketplace (WeMall), including product images, descriptions, photographs, videos, text and other content.

  2. 2. WeMall respects the intellectual property rights of others and requires all users and independent third-party vendors (Vendors) to comply with the Copyright Act 1968 (Cth) and other applicable intellectual property laws.

  3. 3. WeMall operates an online marketplace connecting Customers with Vendors. Vendors are responsible for the content they upload, publish or otherwise make available through the Platform.

Copyright Ownership

  1. 4. All content created or owned by WeMall, including its website design, text, graphics and other materials, is owned by or licensed to WeMall and is protected by applicable copyright laws.

  2. 5. Vendors retain ownership of their original content and are responsible for ensuring they have the necessary rights, licences or permissions to use and publish all content included in their product listings.

  3. 6. Users must not copy, reproduce, distribute, modify or use copyrighted materials available on the Platform without the copyright owner's permission, unless otherwise permitted by law.

Vendor Responsibilities

  1. 7. Vendors must ensure that all product images, descriptions, photographs, videos and other materials included in their listings do not infringe any third party's copyright or other intellectual property rights.

  2. 8. Vendors must not upload, publish or distribute content that infringes another person's copyright or intellectual property rights.

  3. 9. Vendors are responsible for obtaining any necessary licences, authorisations or permissions before using third-party content.

  4. 10. WeMall may review, restrict or remove content that is reasonably suspected of infringing intellectual property rights.

Reporting Copyright Infringement

  1. 11. If a Customer, Vendor or copyright owner believes that any content on the Platform infringes copyright, they should notify WeMall at [Insert Contact Email].

  2. 12. A copyright infringement report should include, where reasonably available:

    1. (a) the name and contact details of the person making the report;

    2. (b) details of the copyrighted material allegedly infringed;

    3. (c) the relevant product listing or URL containing the allegedly infringing material;

    4. (d) a description of the alleged infringement; and

    5. (e) supporting evidence of copyright ownership or authority to act on behalf of the copyright owner.

  3. 13. WeMall may request further information to assess a copyright infringement report.

Copyright Infringement Complaints

  1. 14. Upon receiving a copyright infringement report, WeMall may review the complaint and, where appropriate:

    1. (a) request further information from the person making the complaint or the relevant Vendor;

    2. (b) temporarily restrict access to the disputed content;

    3. (c) remove or disable access to content reasonably suspected of infringing copyright; or

    4. (d) take other appropriate action in accordance with WeMall's Terms and Conditions and applicable law.

  2. 15. WeMall expressly reserves the right, at its sole discretion and without prior notice, to remove or disable access to any product listing, content or other material uploaded, posted or otherwise made available by any user on the Platform that infringes or is reasonably suspected of infringing any third party’s copyright or other intellectual property rights.

Changes to this Policy

  1. 16. WeMall may update this Policy from time to time. Any changes will be published on the Platform and apply prospectively, subject to applicable law.
